title: MT61323: Automation And Process Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, Brief review of measurement techniques of different process
parameters in steel industry; Control valves, Electrohydraulic and
Electromechanical Actuators; Process Control : mathematical descriptions of
SISO and MIMO processes; different control strategies; feedback, feed forward,
ratio and cascade control, Tuning of PID controllers, Model based control,
Digital implementation of analog control; Sequential Control; Programmable
Logic Controller; Distributed Automation; DDC, SCADA and Hierarchical control,
Communication protocols; Case studies related to steel making processes: BOF,
Rolling mills, Materials Handling and Robotics.
